children: RWA Education Session 2 focuses on bStocks and their use beyond trading. The announcement says some bStocks can also be used to provide liquidity on supported DeFi protocols, allowing the assets to participate on-chain in another way. The message presents bStocks as a tool that can be held and used for liquidity provision, rather than only for trading activity. No additional details were provided about specific protocols, supported assets, eligibility requirements, or timing. The post was framed as part of an education session on real-world assets and their on-chain use cases, with the stated topic centered on liquidity provision through bStocks. The announcement did not include any further instructions, promotional claims, or external references.

title: Binance Wallet Explains How bStocks Can Be Used to Provide Liquidity on Supported DeFi Protocols
